summary: This lecture from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) Part 135, led by Sheikh Ali Mashhour, explores the miracles and prophecies of Prophet Muhammad, particularly focusing on his predictions regarding the treasures of the Persian and Roman empires. The speaker discusses how the Prophet, despite being in a position of weakness in the desert with a small band of followers, prophesied that within 23-30 years the Muslims would conquer both Persian and Roman empires and control their wealth. He explains that the Persian emperor rejected the Prophet's letter and was subsequently removed from power permanently, while the Roman emperor treated the letter with respect and his empire was preserved longer. The lecture emphasizes these fulfilled prophecies as evidence of the Prophet's truthfulness and divine mission.
